lines.text: I am an award-winning entrepreneur and best-selling author. I've started, funded…
Mission: develop entrepreneurs to stand out, scale up & make a dent. - 7x startups - 4x exits - 7x bestselling books • Here's where I'd start 👇🏻
If you're new here, this is what I do and why I do it.

What if everything you believed about building a successful business was wrong? Comment ‘Debate’ and I’ll personally DM you the full conversation. Most business advice sounds good, but doesn’t actually work. That’s the problem. We have access to endless content and guru talk, but rarely do we get to see what real operators actually use to build. I brought together three people who have not only built multi-million dollar companies, but they’ve dissected the process so clearly that they can teach others to do it too. @hormozi, @codiesanchez, and @danielpriestley, welcome to The Diary Of A CEO. This has never happened before. Three of the sharpest minds in business, one table and nothing was off limits. We cover: - What’s the most misunderstood game in business? - The business frameworks that will survive the AI era. - The business models that scale from $0 to $59M - How do you build confidence as a founder? - Why product pricing is your most powerful growth tool. - How the best founders think about leverage and passive income. These are three of the people I admire most in this space. They’re the ones I trust to guide me. Each brings a unique perspective, and getting them around one table revealed just how much overlap there is in what actually works. If you’ve ever asked yourself why some people succeed while others just stay stuck, this episode will give you the answer. Sometimes the thing holding you back in business is simply the way you’ve been taught to think about it. Search “The Diary of a CEO Money Making Experts” on YouTube to watch the full episode now.

Comment ‘Daniel’ below and I’ll send you the episode! 💸 The Money Making Expert: The Exact Formula For Turning $100 Into $100k Per Month! 10x Your Income Without Working Harder! The Waiting List Hack That Will Make You Millions! @danielpriestley is an award-winning serial entrepreneur who has built and sold several successful businesses. He knows just about everything when it comes to the world of business and is here today to share all… In this conversation Daniel and I talk about 👇🏽 💥 Why failing is the answer to success. 💥 How to build multi-million pound businesses. 💥 How to take your thoughts from an idea to reality. 💥 Why sales is one of the most important skills you could ever learn. 💥 Where and how to invest your money. Wherever you are on your entrepreneur journey there is something in this episode for you. Open you notes page, and get ready… To watch search ‘The Diary of a CEO’ on YouTube now!
There’s nothing better than a good dad joke…

Such a good reminder that you really don’t need to have everything figured out before you start. You don’t need all the money, experience, connections or the perfect idea. Sometimes you literally just have to have an idea and figure it out as you go hahahah. Full conversation with @danielpriestley is now live on Adulting With Emilia 🤍 Watch on Youtube and Spotify Link in my bio. #danielpriestley #adultingwithemilia #entrepreneurship #youngentrepreneur #makingmoney
